annotations.description: From the collector's redis receiver (redis.memory.used / redis.memory.max). Requires a maxmemory setting on the redis server; the dev compose redis has none, in which case redis_memory_max is 0 and this rule stays silent — set maxmemory or rewrite against redis_memory_used_bytes absolute thresholds.

source: stage25-w4 template — placeholder thresholds; tune before paging
